md
1---
2name: polymarket
3description: Discover and analyze Polymarket prediction markets. Search by keyword/category, get market prices and volumes, track trending markets, find breaking news, and fetch event/market details. Use when users ask about market discovery, odds, trending markets, categories (crypto/politics/sports), breaking news, or searching for markets/profiles. NOT for user portfolios, positions, or trading history (use polymarket-data-api instead). Base URL: https://gamma-api.polymarket.com

35Making API Calls
36
37Use the `requests` library for simple, reliable API calls:
38
39import requests
40
41Get trending markets by 24hr volume
42response = requests.get(
43    "https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events/pagination",
44    params={
45        "active": True,
46        "closed": False,
47        "order": "volume24hr",
48        "ascending": False,
49        "limit": 20
50    }
51)
52trending_markets = response.json()
53
54Search for markets about a topic
55response = requests.get(
56    "https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search",
57    params={"q": "bitcoin", "limit_per_type": 20}
58)
59search_results = response.json()
60
61Get specific market by slug
62slug = "will-bitcoin-hit-100k-by-2025"
63market = requests.get(
64    f"https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets/slug/{slug}"
65).json()
66
67Common Tasks
68
69| Task | Endpoint |
70|------|----------|
71| High-volume markets | `/events/pagination?order=volume24hr&ascending=false&limit=20` |
72| Markets by category | `/events/pagination?tag_slug={category}&active=true&closed=false` |
73| Search all | `/public-search?q={keyword}&limit_per_type=20` |
74| Search profiles by name | `/public-search?q={username}&search_profiles=true` |
75| Breaking news | `/biggest-movers?category={world,crypto,politics,sports,entertainment}` |
76| Sports markets | `/events/pagination?series_id={series_id}&active=true` |
77| User profile | `/public-profile?address={wallet}` |
78
79Response Schemas
80
81Events include: `id`, `slug`, `title`, `volume`, `volume24hr`, `liquidity`, `active`, `closed`, `tags[]`, `markets[]`
82
83Markets include: `id`, `slug`, `question`, `outcomes[]`, `outcomePrices`, `volume`, `volume24hr`, `bestBid`, `bestAsk`, `spread`
84
85Profiles include: `id`, `name`, `pseudonym`, `bio`, `profileImage`, `proxyWallet`, `displayUsernamePublic`
86
87See [api.md](references/api.md) for complete field documentation and examples.
88
89Key Parameters
90
91- `active=true&closed=false` - Live tradable markets
92- `order=volume24hr` - Sort by 24hr volume
93- `limit=N` - Results per page (max 100)
94- `offset=N` - Pagination offset
95- `type=markets|events|profiles` - Search filter (deprecated, use /public-search)
96- `q={query}` - Search query (for /public-search)
97- `search_profiles=true` - Enable profile search (for /public-search)
98- `limit_per_type=N` - Results per type (for /public-search)
99
100Error Handling
101
102- Empty results: Verify tag slugs match exactly (case-sensitive)
103- 404: Check slug/ID format
104- Slow responses: Reduce limit parameter or add caching
105- No auth required for all endpoints
106
107Example Workflows
108
109Find and analyze a market:
1101. Search: `/public-search?q=bitcoin`
1112. Get details: `/markets/slug/{slug}`
1123. Check holders: Use Data API `/holders?market={condition_id}`
113
114Find trending markets:
1151. By volume: `/events/pagination?order=volume24hr&ascending=false&limit=20`
1162. Breaking news: `/biggest-movers?category=world`
117
118Find user by username:
1191. Search profiles: `/public-search?q={username}&search_profiles=true&limit_per_type=10`
1202. Get full profile: `/public-profile?address={wallet_address}`

128| "Show me crypto markets" | polymarket (Gamma) ✓ |
129| "What's this trader's portfolio?" | polymarket-data-api ✗ |
130| "Show me their trades" | polymarket-data-api ✗ |
131| "Who are the top traders?" | polymarket-data-api ✗ |

133Related Skills
134
135- Use polymarket (Gamma API) for market discovery and prices
136- Use polymarket-data-api (Data API) for user trading data and portfolios
137- Often you'll need BOTH: Search for markets with Gamma API, then get user positions with Data API

139Python Examples
140
141The `examples/` directory contains complete, runnable scripts for all major endpoints:
142
143- `search_markets.py` - Search markets by keyword
144- `get_trending.py` - Get high-volume markets by category
145- `get_breaking_news.py` - Get markets with biggest price movements
146- `find_user_profile.py` - Search profiles or get profile by wallet
147- `get_market_details.py` - Get complete market/event details
148- `get_categories.py` - List all available categories
149- `get_orderbook.py` - Get CLOB order book and spreads (advanced)
150
151Each script is self-contained with argument parsing. Run with `--help` for usage:
152
153python examples/search_markets.py --help
154python examples/get_trending.py --category finance
155python examples/get_breaking_news.py --category crypto
